$comment: The one default Rezz template, as numbers — the single source both sides read.
Since 30 Sep 2026 the template IS the owner's LaTeX reference, stored verbatim at
services/docsvc/templates/rezz.tex and compiled with Tectonic for every download.
Every number here was MEASURED off that compiled PDF with PyMuPDF (in PDF points),
not designed here — this file only exists so the web preview and the drawn fallback
(services/docsvc/app/template_render.py) can reproduce the compiled geometry.
docsvc's tests/test_latex_parity.py recompiles and re-measures on every run, so an
edit to either side that breaks agreement fails the suite. Change the template by
changing the .tex and re-measuring, never by hand-tuning numbers here.
The box model both consumers replay:
- Each block is a box `lines x leading` tall; `leading` is the wrapped-line
advance, i.e. the CSS line-height.
- Adjacent boxes are separated by gaps["prev>next"] (margins, additive — the
preview's page is a flex column so they never collapse). A bullet nested under
a role is `bullet2` in a key; a bullet straight under a heading is `bullet`.
Unlisted pairs fall back to gaps.default. Gaps are per-pair because TeX's
spacing (itemsep per level, the reference's negative vspaces) is not a sum of
per-kind constants — measured pairs disagreed with every such split.
- A line's baseline sits f(S, L) = L/2 + S*(asc - (asc+desc)/2) below its box
top, Roboto hhea asc=1900/2048 desc=500/2048 — the browser's own line-box
arithmetic, which is what makes the CSS preview land on the PDF's baselines.
Layout facts of the reference (why some numbers look the way they do):
- A4 at a uniform 36pt (0.5in) margin: fullpage's 1in pulled in by the
template's \addtolength lines. letterpaper -> a4paper is the one licensed
change (owner's call, 30 Sep 2026 — India-first).
- Items are \small (9pt -> 8.97 PDF pt) per \resumeItem; body text 10pt.
- Headings are \Large bold \scshape with \titlerule; this Roboto setup fakes
small caps as plain uppercase, so `upper` is exact, and the rule sits at the
heading box's bottom edge.
- role/job_title are the rows of an indented 0.97\textwidth tabular*: indent
10.8 (the itemize leftmargin), row width 507.58, dates flush right at
margin + indent + width = 554.38.
- Bullets carry their marker as text ("• ") with no hanging indent: wrapped
lines return to the box's left edge.
- Ink is pure black: the reference sets no colour.
The pre-LaTeX design rationale (ATS research of 28-29 Sep 2026: single column,
no tables/photos, contact as body text, heading outranks body) still holds and is
satisfied by the reference; the old 10.5pt-body numbers it produced are gone.
$typeComment: Per block kind: size and leading (the CSS font-size/line-height), appearance
flags read by both renderers, indent off the left margin, and for role the
tabular row's width. bullet.indentNested is the level-2 indent (under a role);
bullet.marker is the literal text the compiled file carries before each item.
